 Advertisement Big success for security forces in Jammu and Kashmir. By: Mir Fareed Srinagar , Nov 8, 2026 17:17 IST Last Updated Nov 8, 2026 17:17 IST Published by Aprameya Rao Nov 8, 2026 17:08 IST Edited by Aprameya Rao Two suspected terror associates were arrested during a checkpoint inspection in Jammu and Kashmir’s Kulgam, police said on Sunday. A Chinese pistol, ammunition and two Chinese grenades were recovered from them.
 The suspects, identified as Tahir Bilal and Muneeb Yasin, were heading towards Kulgam from an orchard or agricultural area when security personnel approached them.
 They allegedly tried to flee but were caught by Central Reserve Police Force and Special Operations Group personnel.
 advertisement ❮ ❯ Read Full Story The seized items included a pistol magazine and two 9 mm rounds. The suspects are being questioned.
 BANNER SEEKS INFO ON 4 WANTED TERRORISTS
 In a separate development, a banner seeking information about four wanted terrorists appeared on a wall of Pratap Park in Srinagar’s Lal Chowk area on Sunday morning.
 It named Mohammad Lateef Bhat, Bilal Ahmad Mir, Mohammad Umar Mir and Abid Qayoom Lone.
 Bhat, a Kulgam resident, is wanted in connection with the killing of a policeman in Anantnag in July this year. Officials said he was active in the Kashmir Valley, while the other three, all from Baramulla district, were believed to be operating from Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir.
 The banner offered a reward for credible information about their movements or whereabouts and assured informants that their identities would remain confidential. - Ends Advertisement Also Watch
